mechanism_criteria.human_acceptance: User accepted the reviewed standard before packaging; existing outcomes were already visible.

target.state: Glycinate plus intact SAM before methyl transfer

mechanism_criteria.basis: Literature-informed author operational bounds, not a directly published GNMT success cutoff.
mechanism_criteria.distance_basis: Fu et al. modeled glycine N within 3.0 A of the SAM methyl. This was modeling based on SAM/acetate crystals, not a measured glycine cocrystal. Both endpoints here are author tolerances.
mechanism_criteria.angle_basis: SN2 alignment; Swiderek et al. report reactant-state mean angles of 162-168 degrees across enzyme simulations. These means are not an acceptance interval; 140 degrees is an author tolerance.
mechanism_criteria.aggregation: One complete N-C-S tuple; do not require four occupied sites when only one SAM and one glycine were supplied.
mechanism_criteria.separation_note: Distance-based diagnostic, not proof of a particular protein pocket assignment.
mechanism_criteria.scope: Single-pair reactant geometry in a tetramer, not full four-site occupancy, protonation dynamics or catalytic activity.

references.use: Proposal 1 step 1 identifies the reacting atoms and selected basic glycine state
Same-enzyme SAM/acetate crystal and modeled glycine proximity; not exact glycine pose truth
SN2 and stabilization of glycine basic form
Reactant-state directionality, author manuscript p.10; neither simulated mean angles nor TS distances become hard experimental cutoffs

mechanism_criteria.reporting_change: Old three-condition geometry included C-S bond intactness. The axis is now reported separately from that general/state check; legacy conjunction remains diagnostic.

case_general_requirements.C_S_basis: Retained author operational intact-reactant covalent-bond window; additional to shared DG geometry checks.
case_general_requirements.SAM_stereochemistry_reporter: rdCIPLabeler.AssignCIPLabels on both declared input and observed 3D chirality
case_general_requirements.legacy_CIP_audit: Compare mismatch atom indices under both algorithms, never compare an old input label against a new observed label.
case_general_requirements.RDKit_bounds_note: GetMoleculeBoundsMatrix may emit a UFFTYPER sulfonium charge warning. No energy calculation is used. Keep explicit C-S state bounds and report the DG S-C bounds for inspection.
